title: Zero influences and constant functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. All influences of $f$ are at most zero if and only if $f$ is constant, meaning that there exists $c\in\mathbb R$ such that $f(x)=c$ for every input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
